content: 1. To prepare the solution, add 10 mL of sterile water for injection (SWI) to a 50 mg vial using the TwinPak® device. Direct the stream of diluent into the powder. 2. If slight foaming occurs, allow the vial to remain undisturbed for several minutes to let any large bubbles dissipate. 3. Gently swirl the vial to mix the contents until fully dissolved. Do not shake the vial. 4. Retain the shield assembly and do not discard it. 5. Use the prepared solution immediately or store it in a refrigerator for up to 8 hours. 6. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. 7. In Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. 8. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. 9. If the symptoms are less severe, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 10. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. 11. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 12. This information was last revised in May 2024. 13.
